propositions: The code-review tests overlay is currently selected only by glob matching on changed test files, not by diff content, causing changes that add declarations without test files to bypass test coverage review.

A new content-based detector must identify added declarations (function/method/class definitions across multiple languages) in the diff and select the tests overlay when declarations are added and no test files are changed.

The detector must extract declared names from added lines using polyglot regex patterns (Python def/class, Go func, Rust fn, JS/TS function/arrow/class) and suppress selection for annotation-only rewrites where the name is also removed in the same file.

The detector must operate on composed diff context (truncated at 60K chars) with per-file provenance and must be portable across languages and repository layouts by using only relative path predicates and docs/data extension skips, not language-specific or src/-rooted assumptions.

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow coverage-gap findings to blocking-eligible status only when the implementing lines appear as ADDED lines in the diff (newly introduced behavior) and name a concrete violating input.
The overlay_union step description and workflow_ops.py must be updated to pass the changed_files list to content_triggered_overlays and name the added-declaration trigger in the description.
